exposure: high Internal and Chance health locus of control
Mode of delivery: Trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC) or elective repeat cesarean delivery (ERCD)
high health locus of control influenced by Powerful Others
outcome: Decision to undergo TOLAC or ERCD
cohort: 197 women who were candidates for TOLAC or ERCD at two hospitals in Israel
finding: A woman's choice of TOLAC or ERCD is influenced by her sense of control over her health, degree of religious observance, and number of children desired.
